item.title: [7.6] Tariff counterpunch: Where Canada is hitting US
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Dow Jones dropped significantly as US President Donald Trump threatened Bombardier's market access. This escalation followed Canada's refusal to certify American Gulfstream jets, sparking counter tariffs. Brent crude futures rose above ninety-seven dollars a barrel after Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure.

WHY IT MATTERS

Escalating US-Canada trade tensions combined with geopolitical oil supply shocks present a multi-faceted risk to global equities and monetary policy paths.
